_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships THIS repo. Data lives here; commands live in .rtc/. A repo with no .rtc/ directory is fully supported — hooks are opt-in by presence.
_comment_tests: No pytest suite here: the tests are four shell suites, so the gate runs them via a declared test_cmd. An UNCOLLECTED suite is a failure, never a pass.
test_cmd: for t in tests/test_*.sh; do bash "$t" || exit 1; done
